knowledge_point.title: Describing an Entry of a Matrix in Index Notation

question.:question/problem:
Consider the highlighted entry of the matrix $A$ given below. Describe it in terms of $a_{ij}$.

$A = \begin{bmatrix}-7 & -6 & -5 & -4 \\ \boxed{-3} & -2 & -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ 5 & 6 & 7 & 8\end{bmatrix}$
question.:question/worked-solution: The entry lies at the intersection of the $2$nd row and $1$st column. Hence, we have $a_{21}=-3.$
